Title: Qud Expanded Community Edition
Description:
[h1]Qud Expanded Community Edition[/h1]
[i]A community-maintained fork of [b]Caves of Qud Expanded[/b] by Mura.[/i]

This is a [b]separate mod[/b]. It does not replace, modify, or take over the original, which remains Mura's and is still available here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1134036260]Caves of Qud Expanded[/url]

[h1]What you get[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Psionic Adept[/b] — a third genotype with 18 subtypes, casters and martial guardians, with sprites by Noble Lark.
[*][b]144 psionic chips[/b] — implantable chips that grant real mutations to genotypes that cannot mutate. Every one of them can be found.
[*][b]Complete weapon and armor families[/b] — bronze through zetachrome, one- and two-handed, with consistent stats and prices across every tier.
[*][b]New weapon classes[/b] — katanas, rapiers, halberds, greataxes, greatswords, warhammers, greathammers, wristblades and more.
[*][b]Effect ammunition[/b] — six arrows (heat, cryo, sleep gas, mire, flashbang, poison gas), four shotgun shells (incendiary, cryo, armor-piercing, takedown) and the scour slug, which rusts what your target is carrying instead of hurting them.
[*][b]A home base in Joppa[/b] — bed, storage, oven and becoming nook.
[*][b]Skill and economy retuning[/b] — more mutation and skill points, eased requirements, adjusted costs. All of it optional.
[/list]

[h1]Options[/h1]
[b]Eleven settings in Qud's own options menu, under Mods.[/b] Each defaults to what the mod has always done, except where marked. Play it as tuned, or dial any of it back to vanilla.
[list]
[*]Mutation points — 16 by default, anything from 0 to 24
[*]Mutant hit points per level, and extra skill points per level
[*]Extra starting skills, eased skill requirements, retuned skill point costs
[*]Starting reputation bonus with Joppa — [b]off by default[/b]
[*]The Joppa home base building
[*]Psionic chips in loot — off closes the supply completely
[*]Chip Interface slots, for you and for other humanoids
[/list]

Psionic Adepts are unaffected throughout: their numbers are the genotype, not an addition to a vanilla one. Each option says when it takes effect.

[h1]New in 2.5.0[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]The scour slug[/b] — rusts one random thing your target is carrying. A rusted weapon swings far slower, rusted gear is nearly worthless until repaired, and a rusted [b]artifact stops working entirely[/b]. It does not need to punch through armor, so it answers what you cannot hurt. It costs you the loot, and it is dead weight against beasts — roughly four creatures in five carry nothing it can touch.
[*][b]The fullerite greathammer is two-handed[/b], like every other greathammer. See [b]Known issues[/b].
[*][b]The flawless crysteel greathammer[/b] drops "two-handed" from its name, so the family reads consistently.
[*][b]Effect shells are cheaper to craft[/b] — the same materials the game charges for the grenades whose effects they borrow.
[/list]

Every change, with the reasoning behind it, is in the changelog on GitHub.

[h1]Compatibility[/h1]
[b]Do not enable this and the original Caves of Qud Expanded at the same time.[/b] Pick one. A continuation defines the same things the original does — 36 script types with the same names — so Qud reports a type conflict and whichever loads first wins. Saves do not carry across either.

[b]The Grand Bazaar[/b] and [b]Experience Curve Beta[/b] are both fine alongside this. Verified by comparing every object, table and script type the three declare — a record-level check rather than a play-test, so please report anything you hit.

Every change this fork makes to a vanilla record is a merge, never a replacement. It does not overwrite vanilla data and should not discard what future Qud patches add. It should also play nice with most other mods. Please report any compatibility issues to me, either via Steam or via an Issue on GitHub.

[h1]Version and saves[/h1]
[b]2.5.0.[/b] Loads on 2.4.x saves — this update needs no new character. See [b]Known issues[/b] for three caveats.

Coming from Mura's original, [b]start a new character[/b]: identifiers changed during the fork, and Qud writes those into save files.

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]A fullerite greathammer already in your save stays one-handed.[/b] Whether a weapon needs both hands is written into the item when it is made, so the fix reaches copies you pick up or build from now on, not the one in your pack.
[*][b]Effect shells need a shotgun obtained after updating.[/b] A gun already in your save keeps the shot it was built with, so the new shells do nothing in it. Any shotgun you pick up or build from now on works.
[*][b]The quill arrow is disabled.[/b] It shipped in 2.3.0 with a bleed that could never fire: the part it used answers only the melee hit events, and a fired arrow raises a different one. The hulk honey arrow takes its place. Quill arrows you already have still fire; they no longer drop.
[/list]
